methods.curated: data/geography/registry/access.json: written sources or mapped geometry (cited)
methods.osm-entrance: OpenStreetMap entrance=* node on the footprint
methods.gate: OpenStreetMap gate on the area outline
methods.area-entry: where a mapped road or path enters the area
methods.path-access: a mapped footway that runs up to the building
methods.drive-access: a mapped service drive that runs up to the building
methods.frontage: inferred: the side nearest the network, no mapped access (low confidence)
methods.point: the destination is mapped as a point

Owner's marked layout (registered to OSM): the entrance is in the re-entrant corner at the hall's south-east end (the notch in OSM relation 3697984), beside the car park between Jubilee and ISH 1. Owner's aerial photo: the entrance block there, white with a flat roof, a round white tower, a portico and water tanks. Earlier evidence (jubilee_hall_4, jubilee_hall_layout) puts the porch at the same corner.
refs: jubilee_ish_layout (owner satellite layout with entrances and car parks marked)
properties.approachText: From the car park east of the hall to the entrance in the south-east corner, beside the white entrance block with the round tower.

properties.evidence: Owner: the four Diaspora halls are one design and are built in facing pairs (Limann and Kwapong, Sey and Jean Nelson); each pair's front entrances face each other across their car parks. Owner photos: the front entrance is a projecting gabled pavilion at the centre of the long facade (tall arched window above a columned porch), on the axis of the car park; the aerial of all four halls shows the facing fronts on one axis with a walkway between them.
properties.approachText: Into the car park between Kwapong and Limann; the front entrance is the gabled pavilion in the middle of the facade facing Limann.

properties.evidence: Owner: every hall also has a back entrance, without a car park. Owner photos: the same gabled pavilion sits at the centre of the opposite long facade.
